content:
maria: Heads-up — console quota tile is reporting ~20% higher burn for a handful of tenants since yesterday's SDK push. Not seeing matching increases in request counts. Anyone else spot this?
ben: saw a couple of tenant tickets. logs show a lot of `quota.attribution: route=null` entries.
akash: sounds like a route attribution mismatch. we changed the routing/header normalization in the py-sdk last night (PR 5421) — the header name casing changed and the server-side parser is case-sensitive for legacy keys.
lisa: confirmed — go-sdk v1.3.2 actually panics on unexpected header format in our internal proxy. stack trace in the ticket.
maria: ugh. so a mix of clients sending old vs new header formats causes the server to drop the route and attributes to fallback quotas? that would explain the delta.
ben: yea. when route is missing, the console attributes tokens to a default bucket which is larger, so quota-per-route math shows higher burn.
akash: quick repro snippet from logs: ```
INTERNAL: Received headers: {"x-rd-routehint":"team:search","X-Rd-Route-Hint":"team:search"}
SERVER: route parsed -> null (expected x-rd-route-hint lowercased)
```
maria: Suggestion: server-side shim that accepts both `x-rd-routehint` and `x-rd-route-hint` and normalizes to canonical route before quota eval. rollout plan: canary shim -> monitor `console.quota.attribution.delta` -> full rollout. Thoughts?
lisa: shim makes sense. but need to be careful for Dedicated customers: quota ledgers are strict for reserved capacity, any reattribution could change billing windows. coordinate with billing.
ben: also need to patch the go-sdk quickly to avoid panics. py and ts already have graceful fallbacks.
akash: agree. propose sequence: 1) server shim that accepts both forms (hotfix), 2) push go-sdk patch that tolerates either header, 3) emit an opt-in debug metric `sdk.route.header.variant` from clients for 2 weeks, 4) flag deprecation window for old header after 30 days.
maria: sounds good. for observability, let's add a temporary console tile showing per-tenant `attribution.delta` (tokens_current - tokens_expected_by_request_count) and alert on >10% sustained for 1h.
\enops: @ops-bot can we add alert and short mute policy for canary?
ops-bot: creating alert `console.quota.attribution.delta` with threshold 10%/1h for canary namespaces. will post link once created.
lisa: about SDK releases: can we do a fastpatch for Go (1.3.3) and a minor for Python (1.9.1) to add header-casing fallback? keep changelog minimal to avoid triggering automation.
ben: yep 1.3.3 for Go with exception handling + unit tests. I'll open PRs and tag infra.
akash: we'll also emit `telemetry.route_header_normalized=true` from servers after shim engaged so console can mark post-fix behavior.
maria: PR owners: @ben for go, @akash for server shim, @lisa for canary dashboard tile, i'll own comms to support/billing.
ben: quick patch snippet for Go: ```go
h := req.Header.Get("X-Rd-Route-Hint")
if h == "" { h = strings.ToLower(req.Header.Get("x-rd-routehint")) }
// parse h...
```
lisa: nice. i'll add a small UX note on the dashboard: "Attribution anomalies? See route header normalization status" and a link to the migration doc.
maria: timeline? ops please canary server shim in prod-cz for 2h, watch delta metric. if green, roll to us-east-1 within 6 hours.
ops-bot: canary scheduled for prod-cz in 10m. will post runbook link.
ben: opened go-sdk PR #5488, added tests. tagging @eng-platform for review.
akash: opened server shim PR #5490, includes feature flag `route_header_compat`. disabled by default. will turn on for canary.
lisa: dashboard tile PR #5492 opened. mockups in the PR description.
maria: one more: we should add an ingest-time log tag `route_normalized` so we can backfill attribution quickly for impacted tenants if needed.
\enops: noted — adding to runbook.
ben: :+1: on backfill plan.
akash: we should also update SDK docs and add an opt-in header backward-compatibility section so integrators know what to expect.
maria: OK action items captured. post-canar y retrospective tomorrow 10am to decide deprecation date for the old header.
devex-bot: ACTIONS CREATED: D-5488 (go patch), D-5490 (server shim), D-5492 (dashboard tile), A-910 (canary alert). Assigned per thread.
maria: thanks team — will update support thread and send short note to dedicated contacts.
ben: on it, will monitor logs for panics after hotfix.
lisa: i'll draft the migration blurb for docs.
akash: standing by to flip feature flag once canary looks ok.
maria: closing loop here for now. if anyone sees new tenant spikes, ping this thread and @maria directly. :eyes:
